authorized_exceptions.source: Chinese prose, API names/symbols/paths accurate English
authorized_exceptions.basis: The current user explicitly requires English-only authoritative documents. This is the narrow language-policy change, not a technical architecture change.

observations: ADR-0001 retains Proposed and its historical proposed-contract statements without silently updating history.
templates/technical-spec.md retains the source statement about optional Rust; this translation does not reinterpret its historical template scope.
The async-quiescence README retains the finite 226/159/9 counts, negative-control pruning qualification, SC/CAS assumptions, managed cancellation caveat and explicit non-product boundary.

coverage-matrix retains historical optional Rust, PostgreSQL pure C# baseline and Kestrel task titles together with its preexisting Source-driven amendment; no present-day architecture is silently substituted for historical text. requirements-map remains coverage_planned_not_accepted with all 28 exact requirement and task-ID mappings.

The registry translation review additionally binds semantic_projection_v1 from the actually reviewed cbedc6a file. The working registry projection was compared exactly and matched: only the declared acceptance-binding metadata may vary; statuses, IDs, versions, dependencies, paths, titles and all other fields remain pinned.
identity_boundary: Actual subagent technical review; not a separate GitHub approval identity.
coverage_note: Independent semantic review of the exact 27 file pairs recorded here: 15 root-authored documents, 21 registry titles in one file, and 11 research documents. All six findings were resolved by their authors and the exact correction diffs independently reread. All 27 entries pass at their recorded target hashes. Integration must match these exact bytes; subsequent acceptance-binding edits need separate integrity review.

findings.issue: Chinese colon/full-stop punctuation remains in two link/blob prose rows.
findings.requested_fix: Normalize punctuation to English while preserving exact URLs and blob SHAs.

findings.issue: The translated otherwise clause can attach to compilation being required rather than to dynamic-code support.
findings.requested_fix: Explicitly state that the throw occurs if dynamic code is unsupported when a new compilation is needed.

findings.issue: Disabling sensitive parameters can imply disabling parameter functionality rather than parameter logging in the stated logging-model context.
Native union can suggest native ABI/Rust/C rather than the built-in C# language union under discussion.
Permission to repair arbitrarily corrupted state can read as restricting repair actions rather than rejecting an unwarranted claim that AssertUnwindSafe repairs state.
findings.requested_fix: Use is not a license to treat arbitrarily corrupted state as repaired or an equivalent precise rendering.

findings.issue: Copying its omitted state and cleanup logic is literally copying nonexistent content; the source cautions against treating a skeletal example with omitted logic as a complete implementation.
findings.requested_fix: Say that copying a skeleton that omits state and cleanup logic cannot justify claiming a completed product implementation.
